reason: The conditional voluntary cash partial offer by Mr. Wang He to acquire 56,320,200 shares has officially lapsed due to failure to meet acceptance levels, removing a key valuation floor for the stock.
why_now: The lapse of the partial offer was formally announced on October 2, 2026.
source_headlines: TONTINE WINES (00389): ANNOUNCEMENT - CONDITIONAL VOLUNTARY CASH PARTIAL OFFER BY I WIN SECURITIES LIMITED FOR AND ON BEHALF OF MR. WANG HE TO ACQUIRE 56,320,200 SHARES IN CHINA TONTINE WINES GROUP LIMITED (STOCK CODE: 389) (OTHER THAN THOSE ALREADY OWNED BY MR. WANG HE AND PARTIES ACTING IN CONCERT WITH HIM) (1) LEVEL OF ACCEPTANCE ON THE FIRST CLOSING DATE; AND (2) LAPSE OF THE PARTIAL OFFER
